name: High Fives Dominoes
description: High Fives Dominoes is a western domino connecting game played with a double-15 set, using the extended value range to create longer sessions and more complex end control. Players match open ends while managing mobility and high-value risk, since high numbers can amplify blocking and pip exposure outcomes.

content.text: High Fives Dominoes is a western domino connecting game played with a double-15 set, using the extended value range to create longer sessions and more complex end control. Players match open ends while managing mobility and high-value risk, since high numbers can amplify blocking and pip exposure outcomes.
High Fives Dominoes is encountered as a modern extended-set format that relies on large western domino sets for long sessions and larger groups.
Domino set and optional score tracking by match profile.
Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles form a boneyard if the profile uses draws.
